title: Space Jam

    StartersBugs Bunny's carrot sticksBaby carrots and cucumber sticks standing in garlic dill ranch dip cupsHow to make it200ml sour cream100ml mayonnaise1 garlic clove, crushed1 tbsp chopped dill1 tbsp chopped chives1 bag baby carrots2 Lebanese cucumbers, cut into sticksMix the sour cream, mayonnaise, garlic, dill and chives into a ranch dip.Spoon some into the bottom of small cups.Stand the carrots and cucumber sticks upright in each cup so everyone gets their own serve.Basketball cheese ballsCheddar and cream cheese balls rolled in paprika and corn chip crumbsHow to make it200g cheddar, grated250g cream cheese2 spring onions, sliced2 tbsp smoked paprika1 cup crushed corn chips1 box water crackersMix the cheddar, cream cheese and spring onions and chill until firm enough to roll.Roll into small balls and coat in the paprika mixed with the crushed corn chips.Mark basketball lines with a chive or skewer. Chill and serve with water crackers.Moron Mountain pigs in blanketsThe alien theme park on Moron MountainHow to make itAs written, serves 4Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips, brushed with egg and sprinkled with sesame, baked golden, with mustard and tomato sauce for dipping.Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 24 strips.Wrap a strip around each of 24 cocktail franks, leaving the ends poking out.Lay on a lined tray seam side down, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.Serve warm with small bowls of mild mustard and tomato sauce for dipping.MainsCourtside meatball subsBeef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce on rolls under melted mozzarellaHow to make it250g beef mince250g pork mince1 tsp salt800g crushed tomatoes4 long bread rolls250g mozzarella, sliced or grated1 cup basil leaves, tornMix the minces with the salt and roll into balls.Bake at 200°C until browned.Simmer the meatballs in the crushed tomatoes.Pile into split rolls, cover with mozzarella and grill until sparkling apple. Finish with basil.Halftime crumbed tenders and wedgesThe halftime team talk in the locker roomHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken tenderloins crumbed in panko and parmesan, baked crisp and golden, with honey mustard dip and crunchy paprika potato wedges.Cut 4 potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, salt and paprika and roast at 220°C for 35 minutes.Toss 600g chicken tenderloins in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 100g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan.Lay on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 220°C for 15 minutes, turning once.Mix 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp mild mustard and 3 tbsp mayonnaise for dipping.SweetsMonstars chocolate puddingChocolate pudding cups with cookie crumbs and gummy wormsHow to make it750ml milk3 tbsp cornflour80g caster sugar100g dark chocolate4 chocolate biscuits, crushed12 gummy wormsWhisk the milk, cornflour and sugar over heat until thick, then stir in the chocolate until smooth.Pour into cups and chill for 2 hours.Top with crushed biscuits and push in gummy worms so they look like they are crawling out.DrinksMichael's secret stuff orange coolerOrange, lime, honey and mint with sparkling water, served in sports bottlesHow to make it6 oranges, juiced1 lime, juiced2 tbsp honey1 tbsp torn mint600ml cold sparkling water1 bag iceSqueeze the oranges and lime into a jug. Stir in the honey until dissolved and add the mint.Divide between four sports bottles, add ice and top up with sparkling water.
